title: Compute change impact and affected validation domains
goal: Translate changed repository paths and work-manifest scope into source-backed affected architecture, product and security validation domains.
invariants: validation selection is conservative when impact is uncertain
security-critical checks cannot be silently downgraded
security_properties: mandatory security gates cannot be omitted by a work unit

performance_budget.rationale: impact selection must remain cheap enough for every PR
metrics: selection control-plane target: sub-second on engineering-only metadata once repository change input is available

migration.rationale: no product runtime persistent data migration

verification: engineering-kernel returns to the prior verified gate set

definition_of_done: unknown changed paths are high-risk instead of ignored
Product Spec changes force product-spec validation domains
runtime dependency and architecture files map to their mandatory domains
impact output records the triggering paths
